protocol.hypothesis: The original downstream-looking region context is zero at terminal POs and cannot locate upstream edits relative to outputs. Replacing only the global residual's last eight features with causal per-output edit summaries may improve joint-combination ranking.
protocol.single_change: Keep the same 20-32-32-1 global head; replace its eight reverse-DAG PO-context inputs with tanh(sum_d sensitivity[p,d]*expected_edit_features[d]) and tanh(sum_d reachability[p,d]*expected_edit_features[d]). Sensitivity is the original structural timing derivative with respect to a common additive delay perturbation at both literal phases of a decision root; reachability is original root-to-PO connectivity. Neither uses candidate Mapping labels.
protocol.scope_of_sensitivity: Fixed original structural timing, not mapped-cell criticality. Frozen reference coefficients do not model candidate-induced critical-path changes; the existing differentiable timing propagation still uses the selected combination. This is a hypothesis, not a proven cause of every ranking error.
unchanged: frozen LiteCut and its saved features
structural timing and no-op PO anchor
original PO Huber + critical Huber + 0.1 pairwise loss
training circuits and historical training domain
Mapper input convention and saved labels

data_roles.train: Original 12 training circuits only update weights
data_roles.development: Original 12 validation circuits already used for diagnosis and checkpoint selection; never called independent
data_roles.independent: No new circuits initially. Only consider a small frozen new panel if development comparison warrants it; never reuse normalized cut-proxy labels without matching.

protocol.severe_reversal: True gap exceeds 5 percent of the circuit's best eight-combination delay and both predictions and labels are distinguishable under the frozen ranking tolerance. Report count over the same true-gap pair domain, not just selected top1.
protocol.advancement_gate: Consider independent confirmation only if three-seed macro pairwise accuracy rises by at least 5 percentage points, Top1 hit does not fall, average regret falls, maximum regret does not rise, and severe reversals do not increase. This is an engineering go/no-go rule, not a significance test. If it fails, retain negative findings and do not tune or try another architecture in this round.
